product_metadata.title: Morezi Metal Bread Bin Loaves Storage Canister Tins - Tight Seal Wood Lids - Countertop Space-Saving, Gray-Coated Carbon Steel Safty
features: 1: Idea Solutions for Food Storage: Bread bins for the kitchen size is 12 3/4 (L) x 6 3/4 (W) x 8 3/4 (H) Inch, can hold at least 2 loaves of bread. Perfect for storing your bread, loaves, cookies, rolls, muffins, bagels or other baked goods!
2: Bread box for kitchen countertop: Hard wearing and durable carbon steel; With classic gray and wood lid design,It is elegant and ease to use.

3: Keep food dry and fresh: Just want a place to keep your chips, hotdog buns and treats without your furry friends getting to it first? This is great for storing your snacks, too! This bread bin will keep your bread fresh for days. The lid is sturdy, but not air tight, by design. Bread needs air flow to stay fresh.

4: Match your kitchen decor - Stylish and simple design will blend in with any décor in your home or kitchen. Any guests, friends or family will be sure to compliment you on this luxurious looking food and treat storage.
5: Easy to take - Perfect for use as a camping gear. A lightweight and keep fresh bread box make you happy on every trip.
